Subject: Trademark guidance + support window exception needed for GCP listing

Hi Ben / Vanessa,

Quick one from our GCP listing review: the marketplace QA team flagged two items for the Redwood listing we’re co-selling.

1) Trademark usage: GCP asks for a short evidence pack showing trademark permissions for the term “Redwood Inference” within our marketing assets (logo, naming in product description). They want explicit permission from the trademark owner or a reseller agreement showing right to use.

2) Support window: CloudPartners runs a standard 9–5 PST support model; GCP’s listing requires at least a 24x5 support window or a documented exception/alternative routing for urgent incidents.

Attached: a stubbed evidence pack template and the marketplace reviewer’s note. Can you confirm if Redwood can provide trademark permission (or allow CloudPartners to use the name under reseller rights) and whether a support-hours exception is doable (we can propose a follow‑the‑sun handoff or escalation to Redwood’s on-call).

Timeline: reviewer is asking for answers by EOD Tuesday (May 31) to keep the listing on schedule.

Thanks — really appreciate a quick turnaround on this.

— Sophie
Sophie Lang
Partnerships, CloudPartners.io
Attachments: reviewer_note.txt (text), evidence_template.pdf (stub)

Subject: Re: Trademark guidance + support window exception needed for GCP listing

Sophie — thanks for the heads up. Looping in KarThik on the marketplace policy side and Vanessa on partner ops.

Short answers up front:
- Trademark: we can provide a short permission letter for CloudPartners to reference the Redwood Inference name in the listing and marketing collateral. I’ll attach the signed permission PDF by EOD Monday.
- Support window: we don’t currently offer 24x5 for partner-managed listings by default, but we do have two feasible options:
  * Option A: Redwood provides a 24x5 escalation endpoint (on-call routing) for production incidents tied to co-sell customers — this requires a one-off ops config and SOW addendum.
  * Option B: CloudPartners documents a follow-the-sun triage process with an SLA-backed first response during business hours plus Redwood on-call for P1s via our escalation channel.

Action items I’m committing to:
1) I will upload a draft trademark permission letter (redwood_gcp-trademark-evidence.pdf) in the Drive link below by 12:00 PT Monday.
2) KarThik — can you confirm whether the ops team can stand up a 24x5 escalation endpoint for this partner? If not, please draft the exception language and required SOW verbiage.
3) Vanessa — please prepare the support-hours exception form (support-hours-exception-form.docx) so Sophie can attach it to the marketplace ticket if we take Option B.

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-example (trademark draft)

I’ll keep Sophie in the loop. Thanks all.

Best,
